title: Varda bento
description: A gapless bento of flat colour blocks on a three-column grid: a wide navy tile with an orange heading and a 2.1:1 video slot (play button) beside it, a tall orange tile with a photo slot filling its foot, a short navy and a short off-white tile, and a wide off-white tile with a photo beside it. Square corners, no shadows; every tile shifts one shade on hover. Phones stack it: video over text, the short pair side by side.
notes: made for the varda theme's navy/orange/off-white roles; other themes keep the three-tone contrast through background, primary and secondary
media slots are empty placeholders until you pass images or video
